sources.claim: In 1956 IKEA designer Gillis Lundgren removed a table's legs to fit it in his car, originating the flat-pack concept
sources.source: Guinness World Records / Inc.com (Gillis Lundgren profile)

sources.claim: Flat-pack shipping/self-assembly became the core of IKEA's low-cost retail model, credited to Ingvar Kamprad and Lundgren

pronunciation_notes.note: not spoken in final narration; referenced in overlay only
